title: Cloud Monitoring: metrics, dashboards and uptime checks

videos.script: A customer says the shop is slow. Is it? {{slow}} Cloud Monitoring answers with time series. Each one is a metric type, a resource, and a set of labels. Change one label and it is another series. {{series}} A counter that only grows tells you little. An aligner turns it into a rate. {{rate}} Then the trap. The average latency describes nobody. Most requests are fast, a few are very slow, and the mean lands in between. The ninety-ninth percentile is the one that hurts. {{p99}} Last, a check from outside. It asks the shop from three regions, every five minutes. A crashed process reports nothing, but the check still notices. {{uptime}}
